Optimal.Notes: The 40 Hz refresh and frame cap deliver a smooth, tear-free experience that suits Valheim's exploration pace; medium shadows and vegetation keep the Viking world looking good without overwhelming the RDNA 2 GPU. Motion blur is off to reduce perceived smearing at 40 fps.

The Deck's GPU sits just below the recommended spec, so some graphical compromises are needed for smooth performance, but the game is very playable handheld.

Optimal.Notes: The 40 Hz refresh lock paired with FSR upscaling gives a smooth, visually pleasing experience that holds well during normal exploration and combat. Drop Shadow Distance to Low if framerate dips in dense biomes or near large bases.

profiles.Summary: Valheim runs well on the Steam Deck at platinum ProtonDB tier, though its Unity engine can be CPU-bound in large bases and during heavy combat. With modest settings reductions and FSR upscaling, stable 40–60 fps is achievable for most open-world exploration and combat scenarios.
